title: SATURDAY EASY CARDIO
subtitle: SATURDAY. STEP-UPS, REVERSE LUNGES, SLOW MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS, BIRD-DOG BALANCE, STAIR HAMSTRING STRETCH, WALL CHEST OPENER. TIMED AND EASY. WARM THE ENGINE, THEN OPEN THE BACK OF THE LEGS AND THE CHEST.

script.welcome: SATURDAY, GRIMES. HALLOWEEN. EASY CARDIO, SIXTEEN MINUTES, ALL ON THE CLOCK. NOBODY'S DYING TODAY, BUT NOBODY'S SKIVING EITHER. THE ONLY ZOMBIE ON THESE STAIRS WILL BE YOU IF YOU DON'T SHIFT. MOVE.
script.rest: REST. WALK IT OFF, DON'T SIT IT OFF.
script.lastSet: LAST ONE. FINISH CLEAN. EYES ON YOU.
script.complete: DISMISSED. TONIGHT IS HALLOWEEN, GRIMES. THE SWEETS ARE FOR THE KIDDIES AT THE DOOR, NOT FOR YOUR GOB. HAND OUT THE BLOODY BOWL, DON'T GRAZE IT. PROTEIN AT LUNCH, GET YOUR EVENING WALK IN WHILE THE GHOULS ARE OUT. MONDAY WE WEIGH, AND I WANT TWO THIRTY ONE. I'M WATCHING.

exercises.name: STEP-UPS (BOTTOM STAIR)
exercises.cue: BOTTOM STAIR. WHOLE FOOT ON THE STEP, DRIVE THROUGH THE HEEL, STAND TALL AT THE TOP, STEP DOWN UNDER CONTROL. ALTERNATE THE LEAD LEG. HANDRAIL FOR BALANCE IS FINE. STEADY PACE FOR 30 SECONDS.
exercises.speakStart: STEP UPS. BOTTOM STAIR. THREE ROUNDS OF THIRTY SECONDS. WHOLE FOOT ON THE STEP, STAND TALL AT THE TOP, SWAP LEGS. STEADY, NOT FRANTIC. YOU'RE WARMING AN ENGINE, NOT FLEEING A HAUNTED HOUSE.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. WALK ABOUT, KEEP THE LEGS WARM.
exercises.speakDone: STEP UPS DONE. ENGINE RUNNING. GOOD.

exercises.name: ALTERNATING REVERSE LUNGES
exercises.cue: STAND TALL, FINGERTIPS ON A WALL OR CHAIR IF NEEDED. STEP ONE FOOT BACK, LOWER UNTIL BOTH KNEES ARE ROUGHLY 90 DEGREES, FRONT KNEE OVER THE ANKLE. PUSH THROUGH THE FRONT HEEL TO STAND. ALTERNATE LEGS, STEADY PACE FOR 30 SECONDS.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. THREE ROUNDS OF THIRTY SECONDS, ALTERNATING LEGS. STEP BACK, DROP SOFT, PUSH UP THROUGH THE FRONT HEEL. CHEST TALL. HAND ON THE WALL IF YOU WOBBLE. NO SHAME IN A WALL. PLENTY OF SHAME IN THE SOFA.
exercises.speakDone: LUNGES DONE. KNEES STILL ATTACHED. GOOD.

exercises.name: SLOW MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS (5TH STAIR)
exercises.cue: HANDS ON THE 5TH STAIR, BODY IN A STRAIGHT INCLINE PLANK. DRIVE ONE KNEE TOWARD THE STEP, RETURN, SWITCH. SLOW AND CONTROLLED, HIPS LEVEL, BELLY TIGHT. 20 SECONDS.
exercises.speakStart: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS. FIFTH STAIR. THREE ROUNDS OF TWENTY SECONDS. HANDS ON THE STEP, BODY STRAIGHT, KNEE IN, KNEE BACK, SWAP. SLOW. THIS ISN'T A DISCO, GRIMES. HIPS STILL.

exercises.name: BIRD-DOG BALANCE
exercises.cue: ON ALL FOURS, HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS, KNEES UNDER HIPS. REACH ONE ARM FORWARD AND THE OPPOSITE LEG BACK UNTIL LEVEL WITH THE BODY. HOLD 2 SECONDS, HIPS SQUARE, BACK FLAT. RETURN SLOW, SWITCH. 5 EACH SIDE.
exercises.speakStart: BIRD DOG. BALANCE. TWO ROUNDS, FIVE EACH SIDE. ON ALL FOURS. ONE ARM FORWARD, OPPOSITE LEG BACK, HOLD TWO SECONDS. BACK FLAT AS A TEA TRAY. DON'T SPILL THE TEA.
exercises.speakDone: BALANCE DONE. STILL UPRIGHT, NEAR ENOUGH. GOOD.

exercises.name: STAIR HAMSTRING STRETCH
exercises.cue: HEEL ON THE BOTTOM STAIR, LEG STRAIGHT BUT KNEE SOFT, TOES UP. HAND ON THE RAIL. HINGE FORWARD FROM THE HIPS WITH A FLAT BACK UNTIL YOU FEEL THE BACK OF THE THIGH. NO BOUNCING. BREATHE. HOLD 30, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: HAMSTRING STRETCH. BOTTOM STAIR. TWO ROUNDS, THIRTY SECONDS EACH LEG. HEEL ON THE STEP, TOES UP, LEAN FORWARD FROM THE HIPS, FLAT BACK. NO BOUNCING. THOSE HAMSTRINGS ARE TIGHTER THAN A SCOTSMAN AT THE BAR. LET THEM GO.

exercises.name: WALL CHEST OPENER
exercises.cue: FOREARM ON THE WALL AT SHOULDER HEIGHT, ELBOW BENT 90 DEGREES. STEP THROUGH WITH THE NEAR FOOT AND TURN THE CHEST GENTLY AWAY UNTIL YOU FEEL THE FRONT OF THE SHOULDER AND CHEST OPEN. SHOULDER DOWN, NO PAIN. HOLD 30, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: WALL CHEST OPENER. TWO ROUNDS, THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. FOREARM ON THE WALL, STEP THROUGH, TURN THE CHEST AWAY. GENTLE. A WEEK HUNCHED OVER A KEYBOARD HAS FOLDED YOU LIKE A DECKCHAIR. UNFOLD.
exercises.speakDone: CHEST OPEN, SHOULDERS BACK. THAT IS SATURDAY DONE. DISMISSED.
